is not allowed (`tests/test_fixtures.py` enforces it against the sha256). Every source
was checked on the page it was downloaded from; only MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, MPL-2.0, CC0,
CC-BY-4.0 and US-government public-domain material is kept. Sizes are bytes.
